ITEM 1 | Pale green cucumber slices, thin half-moon wedges with a darker green rind edge and lighter pale green flesh, about 1 cm thick and 3-4 cm long, arranged in a loose cluster in the upper part of the bowl, covering roughly 20% of the bowl's visible area, moist and firm with a slight sheen | 45
ITEM 2 | Small brown cooked mushrooms, whole or halved caps about 1-2 cm across, golden-brown to dark brown with a glossy, slightly wet sheen and a soft, tender texture, piled in a dense mound across the center and lower right of the bowl, covering roughly 35% of the bowl's visible area and about 2 cm high, sitting directly on the white bowl surface alongside the cucumber | 110
